gre_general.value: The mechanical engineering doctorate does not require the GRE General Test.
gre_general.quote: GRE General Test scores are not required.

toefl_min.value: The mechanical engineering doctorate sets a minimum TOEFL iBT score of 100 for admission.
toefl_min.quote: Mechanical Engineering requires a minimum TOEFL score of 100, IELTS score of 7.5, or Duolingo score of 120 for admittance

ielts_min.value: The mechanical engineering doctorate sets a minimum IELTS score of 7.5 for admission.
ielts_min.quote: Mechanical Engineering requires a minimum TOEFL score of 100, IELTS score of 7.5, or Duolingo score of 120 for admittance

deadline.value: The official page prints a day and month without a year (for example 'Fall: December 1 (final)'), so no Fall 2027 date is stated.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The official programme page states no rule on needing a supervisor's agreement before admission.

funding.value: The official pages checked do not state that all or most admitted students are funded.

entry_route.value: The official programme page does not say whether a bachelor's or a master's is needed.

english_waiver.value: The mechanical engineering page requires a TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo minimum for admission and does not say English-medium degree holders are exempt, so the university exemption is not applied here.

notes: The department minimums are the minimum for one of TOEFL 100, IELTS 7.5 or Duolingo 120. The official deadline 'Fall: December 15 (final)' has no year, so deadline is Not stated. Supervisor and funding are not stated on the page; students are assigned an advisor after admission.
